channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Chelsea Manager Xabi Alonso Faces Scrutiny Over Team Performance
item.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso is facing scrutiny regarding the team's performance, with specific concerns raised about the defense. Despite these issues and fan backlash, Alonso reportedly retains the club's faith. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Houston Jumps to No. 1 in AP Men's Basketball Poll
item.description: Houston has moved to the No. 1 ranking in the Associated Press (AP) Top 25 men's basketball poll. Arizona and Tennessee have entered the top 10, while Michigan has dropped out of the rankings. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AFL Considers Draft Rule Changes, Including Father-Son Rule
item.description: The Australian Football League (AFL) is contemplating significant changes to its draft system, with the long-standing father-son rule being considered for potential alteration. The league has indicated that draft reforms are on the horizon. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Anupama Ramachandran First Indian to Defend World Snooker Title
item.description: Anupama Ramachandran has become the first Indian to successfully defend the World Snooker Championship title. She achieved this historic feat in the recent championship. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: The NFL is reviewing the ejection of Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf from a game against the Philadelphia Eagles. Following the ejection, Metcalf is at risk of missing the upcoming Black Friday game against the Denver Broncos. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: No. 18 USC defeated Louisiana-Lafayette 82-56, maintaining their undefeated status. Separately, No. 7 UCLA dominated Delaware, also remaining unbeaten. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Real Madrid announced that striker Endrick will be sidelined due to a muscle injury. The duration of his absence was not specified. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: South Africa's bowlers dominated Bangladesh on the first day of the second Test, bowling them out for 91 runs. The Bangladeshi batters struggled against the South African attack. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Andrej Stojakovic scored a record-setting 46 points to lead No. 10 Illinois to a 99-78 victory over No. 5 Duke. The win marked Duke's worst home loss since 1989. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois has expressed doubt about whether another goalkeeper will win the Ballon d'Or in the future, suggesting the award is unlikely to be given to a player in his position again. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The NFL released its inactive report, detailing players who will not participate in upcoming games. The report is a standard procedure before matches. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Cincinnati defeated UMass Lowell with a score of 78-68 in a basketball game. Tylen Riley was a key player, scoring 24 points off the bench for Cincinnati. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
